title: RFQ Intake
description: One intake report, as emitted by scripts/intake_rfq.py: the RFQ built from a buyer's free-text message, and the questions to ask back. It is an INTAKE document: it carries no score of its own, no scorer reads it, and producing one can never move score_version. The embedded `rfq` is validated against rfq.schema.json by the script before the report is written, so it is typed loosely here. See references/data-contract.md section 9.7 for the input shape and the reason codes.

report_kind.description: Document discriminator, so validate_output.py --schema auto can route this document without guessing.

schema_version.description: Version of this schema contract, e.g. "0.1.0".

skill_version.description: Version of the skill package that produced this document.

as_of.description: The --as-of intake date. The clock is never read.

message.description: What is kept of the buyer's message. The text is not copied: a chat message names people and numbers (INV-31). Quotes of at most 200 characters appear in questions[] and under rfq.extensions.intake.

ready_for_matching.description: False when a blocking question remains (no product category); `rfq` is then null.

stated_fields.description: The fields the buyer's own words supplied, in the script's field order.

rfq.description: The rfq.schema.json document, status "draft" and score_version "unscored", or null when intake is blocked.

readiness.description: score_match.py's own readiness function applied to `rfq`, so this is the figure Mode 3 will print. Absent when `rfq` is null.

questions.description: What to ask the buyer, in the fixed reason order of scripts/intake_rfq.py REASON_ORDER.
